title: Owner Auto Policy Structure Limits: Vehicles, Drivers, Exclusions and Term Lengths
content:
**Policy structure — Owner Auto Policy.** Each Owner Auto Policy is limited, by liability package, as follows:

| Package | Max vehicles scheduled | Max rated drivers | Max named excluded drivers at one time | Term lengths written |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | 4 | 4 | 3 | 6 months |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 4 | 4 | 3 | 6 months |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | 5 | 5 | 3 | 6 months |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | 5 | 5 | 3 | 6 months |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | 6 | 6 | 2 | 6 or 12 months |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | 6 | 6 | 2 | 6 or 12 months |

**Household listing age (all packages).** A resident of the named insured's household who is 15 or older must be listed on the policy, either as a rated driver or as a named excluded driver. The minimum listing age is 15 on every package.

**Points of judgement.**
- The vehicle, rated-driver and excluded-driver limits apply to one owner policy.
- The excluded-driver limit counts drivers excluded at the same time, not exclusions made over the life of the policy.
- Twelve-month terms are written only on the Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability and Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability packages.
- Hypothetical: a household member aged 14 is not yet required to be listed. A member who turns 15 is.
